groundTruth: A 4-layer Qwen3-architecture model with hand-written weights and a 64-token vocabulary. It answers σ(x) = (7x + 3) mod 64 for the last token x. Layer 1 writes x into dimensions the unembedding never reads; layer 2 writes σ(x) into the unembedding's basis.
metric: top-1 accuracy of the decoded token against the planted variable, at the last position
